summary: st-test recognises another runner's pool sizing whether the runner's file is called st-test or fractal-test.

replay.detail: Local CI tooling only; no stored data is read or written.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: Only the parent name accepted for a sibling's du -sk widens; every other reference is handled as before.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; a fractal-test sibling's du then waits out the 30 s settle.
